serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own authoritative table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities reserved_minutes.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin = the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin = the capacity ledger's reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible - never use it as the booked side. onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy. null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window. daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity' (pickup+swap only, not all orders). null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
